# Most goals in international football: Cristiano Ronaldo and Lionel Messi top scoring charts

India's Sunil Chhetri is fourth while Neymar pipped Pele for the most goals netted for Brazil.

Picture by 2026 Getty Images

By Aarish Ansari

Updated on 19 July 2026 23:03 GMT+0 3 min read

In an era of club **[football](https://olympics.com/en/featured-news/how-to-play-football-rules-field-pitch-free-kick-penalty)** ’s overwhelming popularity, scoring goals while donning the national jersey is still an experience every footballer yearns for.

Then there are a few players who have experienced the feeling over and over again, etching their names in the history books.

Portugal’s [**Cristiano Ronaldo**](https://www.olympics.

...

com/en/news/history-of-indian-football) talisman **[Sunil Chhetri](https://olympics.com/en/featured-news/indian-football-player-sunil-chhetri-isl-top-goal-scorer-indian-super-league)** is fourth overall in the all-time international goal scorers’ list. Chhetri played a major role in India’s footballing fortunes in the last decade, earning legendary status in the nation’s sporting history.

However, it’s not just the 21st-century stars featured in the record books.

Legends like Iran’s Ali Daei, the first football player to score 100 international goals, Ferenc Puskas of Hungary, who scored an astounding 84 goals in 89 matches, also find a place in the roll of honour.

Ali Daei, with 108 goals, is also the top international scorer among Asian players while Godfrey Chitalu of Zambia sits on top in the list of African footballers.
Cristiano Ronaldo is the most accomplished European goal scorer of all-time while Lionel Messi and Trinidad and Tobago’s Stern John (69 goals) hold the continental perches for South and North America, respectively.

Three-time [FIFA World Cup](https://olympics.com/en/news/most-goals-in-fifa-world-cup-football-top-scorers) winner [Pele](https://olympics.com/en/featured-news/pele-kolkata-1977-calcutta-mohun-bagan-vs-cosmos-indian-football-eden-gardens) , with 77 goals in 92 matches, is the second-highest goal scorer for Brazil after Neymar, who has netted 80 goals.

results.title: Erling Haaland reaches scoring record set by Malaysian football legend - VnExpress International
excerpts:
Norwegian star striker Erling Haaland has equaled Abdul Ghani Minhat's record of scoring in 11 consecutive international matches.

A 4-1 win over Italy in the final match of World Cup European qualifiers saw Norway return to the World Cup for the first time since 1998. Haaland scored twice in that match to extend his scoring streak to 11 matches.

This equals the 63-year-old record of Abdul Ghani, the striker with the nickname Raja Bola, or King of Football. Ghani scored in 11 consecutive matches from 28 May 1961 to 28 August 1962. The record was confirmed by the International Federation of Football History & Statistics (IFFHS), according to _Sinar Harian_ .

Ghani was born on Dec. 23, 1935, and passed away on Sept. 28, 2012, at the age of 76. He holds the record of scoring 58 goals in 57 matches for Malaya, the predecessor of the Malaysia national team.

**KreedOn Network**

Most goals in International Football

Image Source- Goal.com

International football elicits either adoration or disdain among fans. Regardless of sentiment, players hold a profound affection for representing their homeland. Each player nurtures the aspiration of hoisting the World Cup for their country amid the gaze of millions of devoted supporters. While [Messi and Ronaldo](https://www.kreedon.
com/lionel-messi-vs-cristiano-ronaldo-the-enduring-rivalry) excel both at club and national levels, the inquiry arises: do other players also boast a higher tally?

Any football player’s greatest dream is to score goals, yet only a select few legends have dominated the global scene. In the history of international football, who has scored the most goals? Several iconic figures have made their impact on the world stage, even though Lionel Messi and Cristiano Ronaldo are among the best. The top 10 international goal scorers of all time are revealed in this updated list!

## **Highest goal scorer in the world: Cristiano Ronaldo  
**

Cristiano Ronaldo Image Source: CNN

Suiiiii!! Cristiano strikes again. The Portuguese broke the record for most goals in international football. The 41-year-old has scored 145 goals in 231 caps. It’s surreal; even at the age of 41 years, Ronaldo is breaking and setting unbreakable records that no one might ever break. No one knows until when he is going to retire, but we surely want to see him stick around for a few more years at least. He is the highest goal scorer in international football history.

## **Lionel Messi**

Lionel Messi Image Source- Biography (BIO.)

The little magician, [Lionel Messi](https://www.kreedon.com/lionel-messi-biography-the-maestro-of-modern-football) , is at number 3 among the top 10 best international goal scorers of all time.
The Argentine finally lifted the FIFA World Cup trophy in 2022. The Argentine has scored 123 goals in 202 caps. He might have a slow start in his international career, but he surely has achieved a lot at the club level. He became the first South American to score 80 goals.

## **Ali Daei**

Ali Daei Image: Getty

The actual record for most goals in international [football](https://www.kreedon.com/how-to-become-a-football-player/) was Ali Daei’s, but Cristiano’s accomplishment has made him grab the number one position. Ali Daei is an Iranian footballer who played for a few clubs in the Bundesliga. The Iranian international captained his former side between 2000 and 2006. The striker enjoyed great success in international football by scoring 108 goals in 148 caps. He is one of the top goal scorers of all time.

A proud moment for all the Indian football fans. Sunil Chhetri is the hero and true icon of [Indian football](https://www.kreedon.com/indian-football-players/) . The striker has scored 95 goals in 157 appearances.

The 41-year-old captains the Indian football team and is currently the fourth-highest goal scorer in the world, behind Ali Daei , Lionel Messi and Cristiano Ronaldo. Chhetri is also the most capped player in the history of Indian football. Chhetri truly finds a place in the list of highest goal scorers in the world.

## **Romelu Lukaku**

Romelu Lukaku Image Credits: Reuters

Romelu is one of the greatest footballers in Belgium’s history.
He has been a key player for the national team for more than a decade. As of 2026, Lukaku has scored 91 goals in 129 international matches. He has represented Belgium in several FIFA World Cups and European Championships. Even in his thirties, Romelu remains a crucial player of Belgium.

## **Mokhtar Dahari**

Mokhtar Dahari Image: Goal

[Mokhtar Dahari](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mokhtar_Dahari) was a legendary Malaysian international who played for F.A. Selangor. He enjoyed a stellar international career and established himself as a top international goal scorer. Playing between 1972 and 1985, the Malaysian international scored 89 goals in 142 caps. After suffering from muscular dystrophy for three years, the player died on 11th July 1991.
